sources.title: Introducing Qwen3-Max-Preview (Instruct)
sources.evidence: Official Qwen launch post names the exact Instruct preview, states more than one trillion parameters, and announces Qwen Chat and Alibaba Cloud API access and agentic/instruction-following capabilities.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: The exact qwen3-max-preview row explicitly dates release to 2025-09-05. Current text describes thinking and non-thinking support; this is current documentation, not proof of thinking support at initial launch.

sources.title: Model inference pricing
sources.evidence: Complete indexed Qwen-Max pricing table explicitly lists qwen3-max-preview with both Non-Thinking and Thinking modes, distinct from the non-thinking-only qwen3-max-2025-09-23 row.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max-Preview model page
sources.evidence: Complete indexed page for the exact qwen3-max-preview identifier documents text input/output, Function Calling, thinking/non-thinking modes and rounded 262K context. Direct reopening returned HTTP 404; used as historical indexed documentation, not proof of live availability.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max: Just Scale it
sources.evidence: Complete indexed September 24, 2025 announcement identifies the earlier preview as Qwen3-Max-Instruct and describes Qwen3-Max-Base as MoE with over one trillion parameters. It does not provide a separate preview configuration or active count. Direct page extraction returned no body.

sources.title: Text generation models
sources.evidence: Indexed September 11, 2026 legacy-model table groups qwen3-max-preview under Qwen3-Max with 256k context and Function Calling. The live October page no longer includes this Qwen3 section; neither representation gives an exact token count for the preview.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max exact model and snapshot specifications
sources.evidence: Parent read the complete indexed primary page, including separately titled qwen3-max-preview and January2026 sections. Both explicitly list262144 context. Preview tables mark Function Calling unsupported across regions; the main alias supports it in Beijing. Direct parser exceeded size limit; current endpoint operation was not tested.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official Qwen3-Max-Preview name; launch calls it Instruct.

developer.note: Qwen developer announcement and Alibaba Cloud release history identify the developer and serving platform.

release_date.note: Exact identifier and explicit date in the official release table.

open_weights.note: Primary material establishes hosted Chat/API access. No exact-preview weight release or explicit primary closed-weight declaration was located; API access alone does not prove weights are unavailable. Baseline false is not contradicted.

license.note: No model-weight license was disclosed in the inspected exact-preview announcement or model page; do not copy licenses from open Qwen checkpoints.

parameters_b.note: Official exact-preview disclosure is strictly greater than 1000 billion, not an exact 1000B count. Retain null because the numeric field cannot express this lower bound.

active_parameters_b.note: Neither inspected developer announcement gives activated parameters for the preview; no count inferred from other Qwen models.

architecture.note: The subsequent Qwen3-Max announcement specifies MoE for Qwen3-Max-Base and relates the preview to Qwen3-Max-Instruct. A preview-specific architecture/configuration was not established; no transfer from an open checkpoint or later hosted revision.

context_window.note: Exact262144 context appears in the separately named model section of the indexed primary card; no inference from rounded256k.

modalities.note: Historical indexed exact-model page explicitly lists Text input and Text output.

reasoning.note: Current official lifecycle and pricing documentation explicitly supports thinking and non-thinking for this mutable alias. Launch material calls the original preview Instruct, so this flag must not be backdated to imply launch-day thinking support.

tool_call.note: Exact preview-specific regional tables explicitly mark Function Calling unsupported; general family-level feature claims do not override them.

description.value: Hosted preview of Alibaba's Qwen3-Max model, announced with more than one trillion parameters for text generation, instruction following, and agentic tasks.
description.note: Replaces generic flagship wording with the exact preview identity and bounded parameter disclosure; avoids implying this remains Alibaba's current flagship.

patch.description: Hosted preview of Alibaba's Qwen3-Max model, announced with more than one trillion parameters for text generation, instruction following, and agentic tasks.
patch.notes: Qwen disclosed more than 1 trillion parameters for the Preview Instruct model, without exact total or active counts. The exact indexed preview card documents 262144 context, thinking/non-thinking support and no native Function Calling. Preview-specific architecture and weight availability remain unverified; later Max revisions are separate.
